method: Actual Windows GUI through computer-use @oai/sky; input followed fresh target-window observations. No mocked model import, seeded preferences or source-only invocation was used for the passing accessible-package checks.

Pasted the existing reference package folder using actual GUI input, selected Remember, clicked Verify folder. Observed Verifying every model and runtime file followed by Model available · stopped. No model files were downloaded or changed.
Actual GUI opt-in wrote app/preferences.json with exactly modelDirectory. The file contained no image, answer, pairing code or authorization token.

No llama-server process was present; the model did not autostart. Source inspection confirms remembered package is reverified by Runtime.import_package.
